name: Astral Town
purpose: Main hub: shop, inn, bank, guild board and pet store.
description: The oldest surviving settlement in the shattered world of Astral, and every adventurer begins their journey here. The guild board, shops, the old inn, and a small pet store lining Market Row are always open.

name: Hearthglen
purpose: Quiet starter town: basic shop and inn.
description: Golden fields ringed by low stone walls, close enough to the Hollow that the children wave at hunters walking in. Warm beds and a small shop, and nobody here locks a door.

name: The Two Crowns: Crownspire
purpose: Royal capital: full services, guild board and pet store.
description: The Kingdom of the Two Crowns, heart of the realm. Sun banners and star banners hang from the same high towers, where King Yato holds court by day and Queen Esta keeps the Observatory by night. Every good road in the Astra Kingdom leads here in the end.

name: Newcomer's Hollow
purpose: Solo tutorial climb for new characters, with a daily floor allowance.
description: A soft-mouthed cave under Astral Town, warm and shallow, where the weakest things in the world wander in circles. Every adventurer's first fifty floors are here.

name: Entry Tower
purpose: First real tower: opens the Foothills progression line.
description: A crumbling tower at the edge of town. Weak monsters lurk within, the proving ground for every new adventurer. One ancient guardian waits at the top.

name: Gloomhollow Caverns
purpose: Early cavern grind for gear, Solars and XP.
description: A cave system under the foothills that swallows light and echoes. The Hollow Matriarch keeps the deep galleries, and the howlers keep the shallow ones for her.

name: Pinewatch
purpose: Forest rest stop: shop and inn between Foothills climbs.
description: A camp of long sheds and stacked pine below the tree line. The mill whistle sets the day, and the sawdust never quite leaves your boots.

name: Stonewell
purpose: Foothills trade town: shop, inn and bank.
description: A hard little town at the mouth of the deep shafts. Lantern light, cold beer, and gemstones sold off blankets in the square.

name: Waymeet
purpose: Midlands crossroads: shop, inn and bank.
description: Every road through the midlands bends at Waymeet. Carters, off-duty hunters and trickster leftovers share one crossroads square, and the little vault has never been cracked.

name: Gambit's Dungeon
purpose: Midlands gamble tower: mid-game gear and XP.
description: The domain of the trickster Gambit. A labyrinth that shifts with each descent: mirrors show what never was, and shadows move on their own. Kikaru keeps the last floor. The halls below are not champions.

name: Centurion's Dungeon
purpose: Midlands endurance tower: mid-game gear and XP.
description: A fortress of endless war. The Centurion's elite legions patrol every hall, growing deadlier with each descent. Celestia holds the last gate. The ranks below her are the test, not masters.

name: The Beginning of the End: Sunken Ruins
purpose: Season 1 ruins: playable only while Season 1 runs.
description: A cathedral swallowed by the tide long before Astral fell, half its spires still stand beneath the waterline. Something in the drowned choir still prays, and it does not want visitors. Season 1 exclusive: grants +10% XP, Fame, and Solars over normal dungeons while Season 1 is active.

name: Millcross
purpose: Midlands market town: shop, inn and bank.
description: Where the river turns the wheels. Grain sacks, flour dust, and the smell of bread on baking day all the way down the towpath.

name: Brindleford
purpose: Midlands river town: shop and inn.
description: A shallow crossing and a stone bridge over brown water. Sheep graze the flood meadow while the tollman waves carts through.

name: Stormpeak
purpose: High Peaks storm tower: high-level gear and XP.
description: The great stair of the High Peaks, where the wind carries lightning and every ledge is somebody old. The climb has one rule: do not stop, and do not look down for long.

name: Crystaldeep Caverns
purpose: Crystal caverns: high-level materials and gear.
description: Caverns of living crystal beneath the peaks, where every sound comes back sharper than it went in. The Geode Sovereign sits at the bottom of the deepest shaft, counting the light.

name: Frosthold
purpose: High Peaks fortress town: shop, inn and bank.
description: A blue-stone holdfast under the high snow. The hall fire has not gone out in ninety years, and the gate bars at first snowfall.

name: Cloudrest
purpose: Mountain rest town: shop and inn.
description: Terraces and tea houses above the cloud line. The bell rings for weather, and the rope bridge swears at everyone who crosses it.

name: The Other Side: Astral Tower
purpose: Riftside tower: late-game gear and XP.
description: A rift between worlds. The creatures here are not flesh, they are pure astral energy given violent form. Bam waits where the tower stops being stone. Nothing on the way up is a master.

name: Ashport
purpose: Riftside port town: shop, inn and bank.
description: A harbor town at the foot of the Astral Tower, where the air crackles on clear nights. Sailors trade in rift glass and tower stone, and the inn pours beer strong enough not to ask what the light is doing up there.

name: The End: Eternal Dungeon
purpose: Endless late-game climb: top-tier gear and XP.
description: The final frontier. Those who reach its depths are said to have touched eternity itself. Esteria keeps the last floor. The long walk below is not a row of champions.

name: The End: The Rift Where the World Sleeps
purpose: World-event raid: lethal aura, server-first title and spoils.
description: A wound torn in the world where the magical air runs thickest. Beyond the veil the End waits, vast, patient, and so saturated with power that the air alone will stop a mortal heart. While its long sleep lies over Astral, to step through is to be unmade on contact. Only when the aura crests, two weeks in, does the way open to those who would end it.

name: Veilport
purpose: Riftside veil port: shop, inn and bank.
description: A port on water that reflects the wrong sky. Lantern stalls, pencil sea charts, and cargo winched in from the veil side.

name: Sealwatch
purpose: Frontier seal town: shop, inn and bank.
description: A ring of black keep-walls built to watch the sealed gate of the Caged Dimension. Hunters stage here before the long grind, sell back what the howl spat out, and count their dead over one last hot meal.

name: The Caged Dimension
purpose: Extreme Frontier prison: high-risk, high-reward grind.
description: A shattered pocket of reality with no exit and no ceiling. The creatures here were never meant to exist, sealed away because nothing else could contain them. Even the strongest titled hunters struggle to survive. There are no bosses to conquer, no final floor to clear. There is only the grind, the howl, and the impossible weight of something that should not be alive pressing down on you with every passing second.

name: Wardgate
purpose: Tower airlock hub: filtered staging, shop, inn, bank and guild.
description: The last gate before the deep frontier. Oaths are sworn in the stone hall, and the great beacon is stacked for war, fire, and name days.

name: The Quiet Mile
purpose: Hidden Heartland road: secret discovery climb.
description: A mile of shuttered houses behind Astral Town that no surveyor has ever drawn. The noise of the square stops dead at its mouth, the way a room goes quiet when someone walks in. Monica walked it at four in the morning, once, and drew it anyway.

name: The Skyshelf
purpose: Hidden High Peaks shelf: secret discovery climb.
description: A terrace on the windward face of the ridge, wide enough to put a glider down on and too steep for anything to walk up to it. The thermals fold back against the rock here, so the wind carries you whichever way you decide to go. Oliver landed on it twice and told the surveyors neither time.

name: The Underrift
purpose: Hidden Riftside depths: secret discovery climb.
description: Under the rift where the world sleeps there is a second rift, older, and a stair cut down into it by hands that were not shaped like yours. The air on the stair is thin and bright and tastes like the moment before a storm breaks.

name: Cradlehold
purpose: Dreamlands entry hub: the only door home.
description: The only lit window in the Dreamlands. A keep of grey stone with a door that shuts properly, and a fog that waits outside it. No ambush reaches this far. Nothing is for sale, nothing is mended, and no one here will heal you — it is a place to stand still in, not a place that makes you better. The way home is the seam of light behind the gate.

name: Lantern Fields
purpose: Dreamlands lantern grind: nightmare loot and decay risk.
description: A field of paper lanterns, all of them lit, none of them hung by anyone. The grass is warm underfoot and hums when you step on it. Small things move between the lanterns at the edge of the light, and they move the way a thought moves when you are almost asleep.

name: Sleepwood
purpose: Dreamlands forest grind: nightmare loot and decay risk.
description: Trees that breathe in their sleep and let it out as fog. Every trunk leans a little toward the path. The deeper wood is quiet in a way that is not peaceful, the way a room is quiet when someone in it has stopped talking on purpose.

name: Drowned Chapel
purpose: Dreamlands chapel grind: nightmare loot and decay risk.
description: A chapel standing in water that has forgotten how to move. The pews are full of people who are not there. Something under the surface keeps time with a hymn nobody is singing, and it is very patient about it.

name: The Distorted Court
purpose: Dreamlands court grind: nightmare loot and decay risk.
description: A court where the room is always a little larger than it was. Thrones face the wrong way. The music is a lullaby played by someone who has only heard it described. At the far end of it, something soft spoken is sitting very still, and it has been waiting for a long time.

name: The Ice Wastelands
purpose: Dreamlands death zone: frozen bodies and rescue carries.
description: White to the horizon, and quiet enough to hear your own blood. There is no dungeon here and nothing to win. Only the shapes standing in the ice that used to be people, waiting for someone who is still awake to come and carry them home.

name: Shanlu Kou (Mountain Road Mouth)
purpose: Sect Empire arrival road: crossing hub and mountain road.
description: The road stops here, and stone stairs climb from the paving into the cloud. The gates above are shut, and nobody has swept these steps in a long time.

name: Cloudpiercer Sword Pavilion
purpose: Sword sect: cultivation training and sect skills.
description: A ridge of bare wind and stone. The stairs end at an iron gate, and above it four hundred swords hang point-down in a hall of cold light.

name: Jade Cauldron Hall
purpose: Alchemy sect: pill crafting and cultivation training.
description: A warm terrace under a green arch, smelling of three hundred medicines. Something is always simmering here, and somebody is always coughing somewhere behind it.

name: Ironbone Fist Hall
purpose: Body-refining sect: physical training and sect skills.
description: A shoulder of rock with the doors cut through the boulders rather than around them. The mountain gets hit more often than it gets climbed.

name: Hollow Moon Sect
purpose: Moon sect: cultivation training and sect skills.
description: A black ridge under a crescent gate that stands open because it has never needed to be shut. Nobody sweeps the floors here, and the floors remember everyone.

name: Wayfarer's Academy
purpose: Academy sect: learning, quests and cultivation training.
description: A crossroads ridge with a doorless gate and one very long table. Everybody here came from somewhere else and nobody asks where.

name: Qingmu Lin (Green Wood Forest)
purpose: Sect wilderness: herb gathering and beast hunts.
description: A forest that talks to itself. Nothing in it is bigger than a cart, and everything in it has been left alone long enough to get strange. This is where the sects send a disciple on their first hunt.

name: Heiwu Lin (Black Mist Forest)
purpose: Sect wilderness: rare herbs and dangerous beast hunts.
description: The old half of the forest, where the canopy closes and the trees have had centuries to think. Foundation stage disciples hunt here, and the careful ones come back.

name: Leiya Ling (Thunder Fang Ridge)
purpose: Sect wilderness: thunder beasts and ridge materials.
description: A bare spine of rock that the storms have been hitting for as long as anyone has counted. Core Formation disciples hunt the ridgeline; the valley below it is worse.

name: Xuemo Gu (Blood Demon Valley)
purpose: Sect wilderness: blood-demon hunts and valley materials.
description: A valley floor under a permanent grey sky, still warm from whatever cooked it. There are no beasts here. What lives here is people, and none of them came to be friendly.

name: Astral Town Hospital
purpose: Healing hub: hospital care and recovery.
description: White walls, a bolted door and a desk that counts coin before it counts patients. Every death in the kingdom ends in one of these beds, and nobody leaves until the bill is settled.

name: The End Dimension
purpose: Private End dimension: collector-only End climb.
description: A full dimension sealed inside the ending of the season. It belongs to the one player who collected The End. End monsters walk its thirty floors, and the last door opens only for its owner.

name: Tower of the Hundred Gates
purpose: Season 2 main scenario: 500-floor tower climb, Stars and Pass XP.
description: The tower was not here before the regression, and nobody built it. Five hundred floors in ten wings of fifty, with checkpoints every fifty and a scenario gate every hundred. Toxic air surrounds the frontier; the only safe approach is Wardgate's filtered airlock. The things inside are stronger than anything in the old world, and the gates do not fall to damage alone. A win pays heavily in Fame and XP, and a little in Stars and Solars. Season 2 exclusive: grants +12% XP, Fame, and Solars over normal dungeons while Season 2 is active.

name: Endless Dungeon
purpose: An endless seasonal scenario climb with its own rank ladder.
description: A scenario without a final floor. Defeat the next incarnation, climb higher and earn your seasonal rank.

name: Fire Nation: Caldera Capital
purpose: Firebending homeland & Crescent Island Temple: train with Uncle Iroh, Fire Lord Zuko, Azula & Jeong Jeong.
description: Built inside the dormant crater of Mountach, the Fire Nation Capital gleams with crimson pagodas, volcanic forges, the Jasmine Dragon tea house, and the ancient Sun Warrior altar where Ran and Shaw keep the original flame.

name: Northern Water Tribe: Agna Qel'a
purpose: Waterbending homeland & Spirit Oasis: train with Master Pakku, Katara, Avatar Korra & Hama.
description: Towering glacial walls, moonlit ice canals, Master Pakku's training courtyard, Katara's healing huts, and the warm Spirit Oasis behind the palace where Tui and La circle in eternal balance.

name: Earth Kingdom: Ba Sing Se
purpose: Earthbending homeland & Beifong Academy: train with Toph Beifong, King Bumi, Lin Beifong, Bolin & The Boulder.
description: The Impenetrable City ringed by hundred-meter stone walls, monolithic Earth trains, the roaring Earth Rumble VI arena, Toph Beifong's Metalbending Academy, and the ancient Badgermole tunnels of Oma and Shu.

name: Southern Air Temple
purpose: Airbending sanctuary & Sky Bison Roost: train with Avatar Aang, Master Tenzin, Monk Gyatso, Jinora & Zaheer.
description: White-and-sapphire towers perched above the clouds of the Patola Mountains, where Sky Bison circle the sanctuaries, Ironwood wind-gates spin in the gale, and the statues of past Avatars watch in quiet stillness.

name: The Boiling Rock
purpose: Fire Nation volcanic caldera prison: Firebender & Mastery drops.
description: An inescapable iron fortress suspended inside the steaming lake of a dormant Fire Nation volcano.

name: The Serpent's Pass
purpose: Razor-thin sea causeway haunted by abyssal leviathans and the Unagi.
description: A treacherous stone spine dividing two inland seas, where fog and crushing waves conceal ancient sea serpents.

name: Wan Shi Tong's Buried Library
purpose: Sunken Spirit Library beneath the Si Wong Desert: Bending scrolls & relics.
description: Only its highest dome pierces the shifting dunes of the Si Wong Desert; beneath lie a hundred halls of forbidden lore.

name: The Forgotten Sky Peaks
purpose: Inverted Air Nomad spires & spirit rifts above the clouds.
description: Inverted marble pagodas hanging from sheer sky-cliffs where gale spirits and ancient wind echoes test every step.
